div.seg: Message me directly | Send a request first

p.hint: With “Send a request first,” Hush asks a new person to send one text message as a request before a one-on-one chat. Chats you already have aren’t affected. People can still add you to groups and channels.
label.toggle: Show my online status and last seen
p.hint: People you can see in Hush will see when you’re online. Turn it off and they’ll see “last seen recently” instead.
p.hint: Nothing is blocked. You can block a person from their profile or a chat’s menu, or block someone from a group you run in its member list.

p.hint: On: your messages are restored when you log in on a new phone. Off: older messages stay only on the devices that already have them, so a stolen password reveals nothing from before.
p.hint: Shows your messages the way Hush keeps them: scrambled text that only the people in the chat can unlock. A way to see for yourself that Hush can’t read them.
